review.selectedNextStep: Adapt the existing original cusp common-disk valuation argument to the literal auxiliary cover field: connected meromorphic uniqueness transports field laws to every disk point; the actual place uniformizer has order one, hence analytic normal form with nonzero derivative; its nearby differences generate actual normalized places. Supply a consumer using the existing actual torsion-cover common disk, not an assumed cover chart.
review.shorterRouteAssessment: The existing generic algebraic local/unramified chart modules identify valuation localizations and differential orders, but do not provide analytic place families. Reuse their native Place object and the existing order-one place constructor; adapt only the field-dependent part of the original cusp analytic argument. No general Jacobian representability or arbitrary-curve compactification is introduced.

review.discharged: Every specified place of the literal original complex torsion cover is the center of a positive-disk family of actual normalized cover places. The chosen disk functions retain their exact convergent Laurent representations; membership and order agree with each family place. The original cover uniformizer is analytic with nonzero derivative throughout a smaller disk. These facts consume the local splitting-field realization and native order-one place construction, without assuming a chart or divisor-class division.
